grh_0aedf52f72be77da5ad6.title: The City Manager
paragraphs: Felicity's technocratic city manager pursues efficiency by automating jobs, cutting welfare, forcing much of the population underground, and centralizing transportation, elevators, refrigeration and ventilation under a single master control system. Councilman Jed Hornsby repeatedly warns that the city has been engineered without regard for people. Hornsby finally demonstrates the system's fatal weakness by pulling its single power plug. The manager attacks him, the plug falls down an elevator shaft, and the manager is left trapped in the dark, airless city he designed, unable to restart anything without the plug he cannot reach.

This [[show|theater-five|Theater Five]] broadcast aired on November 16, 1964. It is listed as episode 76 in the archive. [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Leon Janney, Owen Jordan, Charles Randall, Jack Hurdle, and Marty Folia. Other credited names include Ted Bell as director, Robert Cenedella as writer, and Fred Foy as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 21 minutes.
